name: White House
description: Follow White House, a tracked organization, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Trump says execution of Fort Hood shooter will not be livestreamed
changes.summary: President Trump announced that the firing squad execution of Fort Hood shooter Nidal Hasan will not be livestreamed, overriding Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth’s earlier claim that it would be. NBC News' Monica Alba reports the latest details from the White House.

changes.title: Nvidia, Apple, Google, Microsoft, Amazon, and Meta gave Trump a combined $92 million for his ballroom
changes.summary: We knew that a number of big tech firms were helping to fund the construction of Trump's ballroom, but we didn't know just how much they were giving to the cause. Now the Washington Post published a list of all the major donors to the White House ballroom project, along with how much each contributed. In total, Silicon.

changes.title: CNN, MS NOW and Politico prevail against White House — for now
changes.summary: A federal judge ruled late Tuesday that President Trump cannot ban news organizations from covering him at the White House because he does not like the nature of their coverage - at least, not until the matter goes to a formal trial. (Image credit: Graeme Sloan).

changes.title: Katie Zacharia's debut shows the pitfalls and possibilities of White House press secretary's role
changes.summary: This would not be an easy job under any circumstances.

changes.title: Attorney for banned outlets on legal fight over White House press access
changes.summary: A federal judge has once again ordered the White House to restore access for three news organizations President Trump banned last month over their coverage of his administration. The judge ordered full access for CNN, MS NOW and Politico while their legal challenge moves forward. Geoff Bennett discussed more with Ted B.

changes.title: Judge extends order blocking Trump from banning CNN, MS NOW and Politico reporters from White House
changes.summary: A federal judge on Tuesday extended an order blocking President Donald Trump's administration from banning reporters for three news outlets from the White House, a pivotal operational development for the organizations as the extraordinary case — pitting the president against the media that cover him — makes its way thr.

changes.title: How the House landscape is evolving: From the Politics Desk
changes.summary: Welcome to From the Politics Desk, a daily newsletter that brings you the NBC News Politics team’s latest reporting and analysis from the White House, Capitol Hill and the campaign trail.

changes.title: Judge blocks Trump's White House ban targeting CNN, MS NOW and Politico, saying it likely violated 1st Amendment
changes.summary: U.S. District Judge Timothy Kelly said the White House's revocation of hard passes for CNN, MS NOW and Politico journalists likely violated their First and Fifth Amendment rights.

changes.title: Kimberly Guilfoyle Resigns as Ambassador to Greece
changes.summary: Ms. Guilfoyle was asked to quit by the White House after a string of damaging reports, including that she had asked a Republican donor to pay off a credit card.

changes.title: Controversy over new White House press secretary Katie Zacharia's legal credentials
changes.summary: Questions are rising over new White House press secretary Katie Zacharia's legal credentials and where she took her bar exam. CBS News' Nancy Cordes reports.
